item.cirno.cirno.tooltip: A Fairy who cannot live alon
item.cirno.oathpin.tooltip: A vow sealed in white petals.
item.cirno.oathpin.tooltip2: She will never leave your side.
item.cirno.oathpin.tooltip3: Hold in your main hand to unlock "+ Add" in the Cirno Panel (hold H).
item.cirno.oathpin.tooltip4: Look at one of your maids and press "+ Add" to transform her into a command Cirno.
item.cirno.oathpin.tooltip5: Command Cirnos need no Curious item. Uses a free slot; works in survival.
item.cirno.spirit.tooltip: a Spirit who cannot exist without sharing a body of a living being
item.cirno.tatsumaki.tooltip: Tornado Terror with strong telekinesis power
